title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
author: Tracy Chevalier
summary: In 1660s Delft, a sixteen-year-old girl takes a job as a maid in the household of the painter Vermeer. Her quiet eye for colour and light draws her closer to him, to the displeasure of his family.
readIf: you want a short, restrained novel about art, class and desire expressed in small gestures.
skipIf: you want real historical detail on Vermeer; the characters and relationships are invented.

pairings.reason: Another delicate story of a servant whose feelings are never openly spoken.
A classic about a young woman of low status who forms a deep attachment to the man of the house.
Similarly follows a young woman at the mercy of others, in a more ornate and romantic style.
